panels.question: Does L = lambda W hold for checkout per pod 00:00-00:15Z?

annotations.label: L and lambda W diverge: backlog builds and drains
annotations.author: claude

hypotheses.statement: an arrival-rate surge above capacity (overload) built a backlog on every checkout pod
hypotheses.author: claude

hypotheses.statement: the latency timer misses part of the time in system (hidden queueing)
hypotheses.author: claude

findings.claim: On checkout-0, checkout-1 and checkout-2, L rose above lambda W only in the windows 00:05-00:07Z (ratio 1.9 [1.6, 2.2]): a transient overload, special cause; the arrival rate rose to 15/s per pod while capacity is 10/s.
findings.author: claude

findings.claim: Outside 00:05-00:07Z L and lambda W agree within the interval on every pod: no systematic offset, so nothing the latency timer leaves out.
findings.author: claude

transcript.result: h1 supported (f1): a transient overload 00:05-00:07Z (a1); h2 refuted (f2).
